archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Modified for Dark Mode)

hierarchy.kpi_value: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-light tracking-tight text-zinc-100 font-mono

typography.instructions: Use Manrope for clean, professional headings. Use IBM Plex Mono for KPI numbers, tabular data, and IDs to maintain horizontal alignment. Never use Inter for headings.

colors.instructions: Maintain high contrast. Do not use teal green/blue. Rely on Zinc scale for neutrals. Ensure text over surfaces meets 4.5:1 contrast.

surface_strategies.cards: Use 'Grid Borders' or 'Technical Look'. Flat backgrounds (bg-zinc-900), strict 1px solid borders (border-zinc-800). No drop shadows in dark mode. Radius should be max 8px (rounded-lg).
surface_strategies.headers: If sticky, use Solid Background (bg-zinc-950) with a hard bottom border (border-zinc-800). NEVER fully transparent.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol - Mode B (High Density Grid). Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Gap strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6).
spacing_and_layout.padding: Cards need internal padding (p-4 or p-6). Avoid text collision with borders.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Mobile-first. Left-align text and labels. Right-align numerical data in tables. Use optical alignment.

components.kpi_cards: Top row. 4 columns. Minimalist: Title (label), Value (mono), and a subtle sparkline or trend indicator.

charts.time_series: AreaChart for daily/monthly processing volume. Use gradient fill with 0 opacity at bottom.
charts.status_distribution: DonutChart (PieChart with innerRadius) for Status. Use status colors.
charts.category_distribution: BarChart for 'Kategori Perubahan'. Horizontal orientation if labels are long.
charts.pic_performance: Stacked BarChart for PIC Maker & Checker performance (workload/completion).
charts.channel_distribution: RadarChart or BarChart for ROBO, SBN, TP, BL, UMROH.

components.filters: Top filter bar below header: Date Range Picker (calendar), Category Multi-select, PIC Dropdown, Status Filter. Use Shadcn UI components.
components.data_table: Recent Activity table. Pagination, search input, and 'Export CSV' button. Sticky header. Dense padding (py-2 px-3).
components.insights_panel: Side or bottom panel emphasizing reject reasons (e.g., 'BELUM UPDATE REKENING', 'DATA NASABAH NOT FOUND'). Use rose/red accent for critical insights.
components.general: Use Shadcn components for complex interactions but strip Vercel look via Tailwind.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Add transitions specifically to transform, opacity, colors. Example: 'transition-colors duration-200'.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Clear hover states for table rows and buttons.
motion_and_interactions.rules: Disable animations for prefers-reduced-motion. DO NOT use 'transition: all'.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='filter-status-dropdown', data-testid='export-csv-button').
accessibility_and_testing.focus: Focus states must have high contrast: 'focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none'.

images_and_assets.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. They provide a dense, technical feel suitable for dashboards.

urls.description: Subtle abstract dark blue waves. Can be used at 5% opacity for a premium login background if needed. Otherwise, keep dashboard solid dark.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Use 1px solid borders and flat surfaces for this dashboard. Do not use soft drop shadows.
NEVER apply universal transition (transition: all). It breaks transforms. Target specific properties.
NEVER center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emojis like 🤖🧠💭 for icons.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Use Shadcn calendar for date pickers, dropdown-menu for selects.
Ensure the dataset (3000 rows dummy data) is processed efficiently, maybe paginated locally.
